table_description: Dimension table for catalog pages (physical or digital catalogs). Each row represents a specific page in a specific catalog number. Referenced by CATALOG_SALES.CS_CATALOG_PAGE_SK to identify which catalog page an item was ordered from. Used to measure per-catalog and per-page performance.
use_cases: Catalog page revenue and order volume
data_quality_notes: CP_CATALOG_NUMBER identifies the catalog edition (issue number).
CP_CATALOG_PAGE_NUMBER is the physical page number within that catalog.
CP_START_DATE_SK and CP_END_DATE_SK define when this catalog was active.
CP_DEPARTMENT is the merchandising department for this page.

table_columns.name: CP_CATALOG_PAGE_SK
table_columns.description: Surrogate primary key. Referenced by CATALOG_SALES.CS_CATALOG_PAGE_SK.

table_columns.name: CP_START_DATE_SK
table_columns.description: FK to DATE_DIM. When this catalog page became active.

table_columns.name: CP_END_DATE_SK
table_columns.description: FK to DATE_DIM. When this catalog page expired.

table_columns.name: CP_DEPARTMENT
table_columns.description: Merchandising department for this catalog page.

table_columns.name: CP_CATALOG_NUMBER
table_columns.description: Catalog edition/issue number. Groups pages from the same catalog print run.

table_columns.name: CP_CATALOG_PAGE_NUMBER
table_columns.description: Physical page number within the catalog.

table_columns.name: CP_DESCRIPTION
table_columns.description: Free-text description of the catalog page content.
